The sky is a vibrant blue, dotted with fluffy white clouds that drift slowly across the expanse. In the lower portion of the frame, the tops of trees and rooftops are visible, adding depth to the composition. The trees appear lush and green, suggesting a healthy, natural environment. The rooftops are simple and unadorned, indicating a residential or suburban setting. Throughout the video, the clouds continue their gentle movement, creating a dynamic yet peaceful atmosphere. The overall scene remains tranquil, with no significant changes in the objects or scenery, maintaining a consistent and calming visual experience.

caption: The video captures a low-angle daytime view of a bright blue sky, the sun blazing near the top-center and casting a fixed lens flare—a rainbow streak beneath it and a faint halo at the upper right. The camera holds steady, so the silhouetted tree tops and the house roof with chimney and antenna stay locked along the bottom edge. Scattered white cumulus and wispy clouds fill the frame, drifting slowly across the sky. The cloud mass at the left edge creeps rightward, while the mid-right cluster shifts a touch. A puffy cloud in the upper-right corner enters the view and enlarges. The horizontal wispy band in the lower-middle reshapes only modestly. Tiny dark specks flicker at isolated spots, too sparse to follow. Throughout, the glare and foreground stay fixed while the clouds keep passing.

not ground truth. Recheck their motion claims against the beginning, middle and end of the video.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.
The caption itself must directly describe the video: no mention of annotation, images, sampling,
timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
Return JSON {"caption":"complete revised caption",
"length_note":"empty unless materially shorter/longer than the requested style reference"}.
